literal: Shengzong, Part Two
idiomatic: Shengzong, Part Two

literal: In the fourth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on jiaxu day, watched fishing at the Tuhu River.
idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tonghe, on jiaxu day of the first spring month, the Emperor watched fishing at the Tuhu River.

literal: yulin Yelü Molugu and Zhangde Army military commissioner Xiao Talan submitted captives from the eastern campaign; an edict praised and commended them.
idiomatic: yulin Yelü Molugu and Zhangde Army military commissioner Xiao Talan reported captives from the eastern campaign; an edict commended them.

literal: On bingzi day Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Xiezhen, yulin Qinde, and others submitted more than a hundred thousand captives, more than two hundred thousand horses, and other goods taken in the campaign against the Jurchen.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Xiezhen, yulin Qinde, and others reported more than a hundred thousand captives, more than two hundred thousand horses, and other goods taken in the Jurchen campaign.

literal: On jimao day the Emperor paid court to the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On jimao day the Emperor attended court before the Empress Dowager.

literal: Pending lawsuits were decided.
idiomatic: The court cleared backlogged lawsuits.

literal: On renwu day Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen, yulin Qinde, Molugu, military commissioner Talan, army commander Shiluo, Palace Attendant Mojie, Xi princely house overseer Dilie, and Anji and others, having conquered the Jurchen and returned with the army, were sent the attendant Niliji with an edict to commend their merit; he still clasped hands and comforted them, and granted wine and fruit to reward them.
idiomatic: On renwu day Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen, yulin Qinde, Molugu, military commissioner Talan, army commander Shiluo, Palace Attendant Mojie, Xi princely house overseer Dilie, and Anji and others, having broken the Jurchen and returned, were sent the attendant Niliji with an edict commending their merit; he clasped their hands in reassurance, granted wine and fruit, and rewarded them.

literal: On jiawu day the court visited Changbiao.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the Emperor went to Changbiao.

literal: In the second month, on renyin day, Fourth Banner supreme army commander Li Jizhong was made honorary Sikong and Grand Pillar of State.
idiomatic: On renyin day in the second month Li Jizhong, supreme army commander of the fourth banner, was granted honorary Sikong and Grand Pillar of State.

literal: On guimao day Li Jiqian of Western Xia rebelled against Song and came to submit; he was appointed Dingnan Army military commissioner, commissioner for the observation and disposition of Yin, Xia, Sui, and You prefectures, specially advanced honorary Grand Preceptor, and commander-in-chief of all military affairs in Xia Prefecture.
idiomatic: On guimao day Li Jiqian of Western Xia defected from Song and submitted; he was made Dingnan Army military commissioner, commissioner for the observation and disposition of Yin, Xia, Sui, and You prefectures, specially advanced honorary grand preceptor, and commander-in-chief of all military affairs in Xia Prefecture.

literal: Western Tribes chieftain Waniqiyi was made Baoda Army military commissioner and commissioner for the observation and disposition of Fufang and other prefectures.
idiomatic: The Western Tribes chieftain Waniqiyi was appointed Baoda Army military commissioner and commissioner for the observation and disposition of Fufang and other prefectures.

literal: On jiayin day Yelü Xiezhen, Xiao Talan, Molugu, and other tribal chiefs came to court; the yinzhi rite was performed; rewards were granted in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Yelü Xiezhen, Xiao Talan, Molugu, and other tribal chiefs came to court; the court performed the yinzhi rite and rewarded them according to rank.

literal: On bingyin day the court halted at Naolijing.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the court encamped at Naolijing.

literal: In the third month, on jiaxu day, yuyue Xiuge memorialized that Song had sent Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and Mi Xin by the Xiongzhou route, Tian Chongjin by the Feihu route, and Pan Mei and Yang Jiye by the Yanmen route to invade; Qigou, Zhuo Prefecture, Gu'an, and Xincheng had all fallen.
idiomatic: In the third month, on jiaxu day, yuyue Xiuge reported that Song had sent Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and Mi Xin by the Xiongzhou route, Tian Chongjin by the Feihu route, and Pan Mei and Yang Jiye by the Yanmen route to invade; Qigou, Zhuo Prefecture, Gu'an, and Xincheng had all fallen.

literal: An edict ordered Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling to ride swiftly to southern Yan to consult with Xiuge on military affairs;
idiomatic: An edict ordered Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling to ride at once to southern Yan to consult with Xiuge on military affairs;

literal: envoys were dispatched separately to levy troops from the various divisions to reinforce Xiuge and strike the enemy;
idiomatic: envoys were sent separately to levy troops from the various divisions to reinforce Xiuge and strike the invaders;

literal: Eastern Capital regent Yelü Mojie was again sent with the main army to follow up, and was granted a sword authorizing summary execution.
idiomatic: Eastern Capital regent Yelü Mojie was again ordered forward with the main army, and was granted a sword authorizing summary execution.

literal: On yihai day notification of the personal campaign was sent to the mausoleums, temples, and mountains and rivers.
idiomatic: On yihai day the court notified the imperial mausoleums, temples, and mountains and rivers that the Emperor would campaign in person.

literal: On bingzi day army commander Yelü Pide defeated the Song army at Gu'an; Xiuge cut off their grain supply, captured officers, and seized very many horses, cattle, and weapons.
idiomatic: On bingzi day army commander Yelü Pide routed the Song army at Gu'an; Xiuge cut off their supplies, captured officers, and seized vast numbers of horses, cattle, and weapons.

literal: On gengchen day Huan Prefecture prefect Zhao Yanzhang rebelled with the city and went over to Song.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Huan Prefecture prefect Zhao Yanzhang surrendered the city and defected to Song.

literal: On xinsi day Song troops entered Zhuo Prefecture.
idiomatic: On xinsi day Song forces entered Zhuo Prefecture.

literal: Shunyi Army deputy military commissioner Zhao Xizan rebelled with Shuozhou and went over to Song.
idiomatic: Shunyi Army deputy military commissioner Zhao Xizan surrendered Shuozhou and defected to Song.

literal: At that time the Emperor and the Empress Dowager were encamped at Tuoluokou; an edict urged the eastern levies to march as reinforcements.
idiomatic: At that time the Emperor and the Empress Dowager were encamped at Tuoluokou; an edict ordered the eastern levies to hurry forward as reinforcements.

literal: On renwu day an edict ordered yulin Qinde to hold the Pingzhou coast with troops against Song.
idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered yulin Qinde to hold the Pingzhou coast with troops against Song.

literal: Pingzhou military commissioner Diligu was also notified that if Qinde had not yet arrived, men should be sent to urge him on;
idiomatic: Pingzhou military commissioner Diligu was also told that if Qinde had not yet arrived, men should be sent to hurry him forward;

literal: if horses were lacking, civilian horses were to be requisitioned;
idiomatic: if horses ran short, civilian horses were to be requisitioned;

literal: if armor was lacking, it was to be taken from the armory at Xian Prefecture.
idiomatic: if armor ran short, it was to be taken from the armory at Xian Prefecture.

literal: On guiwei day the Liao army fought Tian Chongjin of Song at Feihu with an unfavorable outcome; Jizhou defense commissioner Da Pengyi, Kang Prefecture prefect Ma Yun, and cavalry commander He Wantong were captured.
idiomatic: On guiwei day the Liao army fought Tian Chongjin of Song at Feihu and was defeated; Jizhou defense commissioner Da Pengyi, Kang Prefecture prefect Ma Yun, and cavalry commander He Wantong were taken.

literal: On dinghai day Northern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Xiezhen was made overall commander of Shanxi horses and troops, Northern Court Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling was made overall commander of the southern campaign, and both were made deputies to yuyue Xiuge.
idiomatic: On dinghai day Northern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Xiezhen was made overall commander of Shanxi horses and troops, Northern Court Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling was made overall commander of the southern campaign, and both served as deputies to yuyue Xiuge.

literal: Zhangguo Army military commissioner Ai Zheng and administrative aide Song Xiong rebelled with Ying Prefecture and went over to Song.
idiomatic: Zhangguo Army military commissioner Ai Zheng and administrative aide Song Xiong surrendered Ying Prefecture and defected to Song.

literal: On gengyin day Flying Dragon envoy Yala and clerical officer Yadage were sent to inspect horses to supply the armies going out first; an edict put Imperial Son-in-law Commander Xiao Jiyuan in charge.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Flying Dragon envoy Yala and clerical officer Yadage were sent to inspect horses for the armies marching out first; an edict put Imperial Son-in-law Commander Xiao Jiyuan in charge.

literal: On xinmao day Wuding Army cavalry-and-infantry commander and Ying Prefecture defense commissioner Lü Xingde, deputy commander Zhang Jicong, and cavalry commander Liu Zhijin and others rebelled with Feihu and went over to Song.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Wuding Army cavalry-and-infantry commander and Ying Prefecture defense commissioner Lü Xingde, deputy commander Zhang Jicong, cavalry commander Liu Zhijin, and others surrendered Feihu and defected to Song.

literal: On guisi day yulin Molugu was granted four flags and drums and one sword, and was to lead the elite of the forbidden army south to assist Xiuge.
idiomatic: On guisi day yulin Molugu was granted four sets of flags and drums and one sword, and ordered to lead the elite of the forbidden army south to assist Xiuge.

literal: On bingshen day infantry commander Mu Chao rebelled with Lingqiu and went over to Song.
idiomatic: On bingshen day infantry commander Mu Chao surrendered Lingqiu and defected to Song.

literal: An edict dispatched envoys to grant Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen secret instructions and the seal of Zhangguo Army military commissioner Shaowa to hasten the campaign.
idiomatic: An edict sent envoys to give Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen secret instructions and the seal of Zhangguo Army military commissioner Shaowa to hurry the campaign.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on the jihai new moon, the court halted at the northern suburbs of Nanjing.
idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the fourth summer month the court encamped at the northern suburbs of Nanjing.

literal: On gengzi day tihu Yaosheng and Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei reported victory.
idiomatic: On gengzi day tihu Yaosheng and Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei reported victory.

literal: On xinchou day Pan Mei of Song captured Yun Prefecture.
idiomatic: On xinchou day Pan Mei of Song took Yun Prefecture.

literal: On renyin day Mojie, Molugu, Qinde, and others were sent to lead detached forces to assist Xiuge, and were again granted flags and drums and the Shaowa seal to comfort and instruct the officers.
idiomatic: On renyin day Mojie, Molugu, Qinde, and others were ordered to lead detached forces to assist Xiuge, and were again granted flags and drums and the Shaowa seal to reassure the officers.

literal: On guimao day Xiuge again reported victory; the Emperor used wine and dried meat to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On guimao day Xiuge again reported victory; the Emperor offered wine and dried meat in sacrifice to heaven and earth.

literal: Leading the ministers, he congratulated the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: He led the ministers in offering congratulations to the Empress Dowager.

literal: An edict ordered Qinde to return with the army.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Qinde to withdraw the army.

literal: On bingwu day Pide submitted the count of captured armor and weapons.
idiomatic: On bingwu day Pide submitted the tally of captured armor and weapons.

literal: On wushen day overseer and Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling memorialized that the enemy army had withdrawn, while Xi King Chouning, Northern Court Great King Pununing, army commander Pide, and others pursued with troops and all were victorious.
idiomatic: On wushen day overseer and Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling reported that the enemy had withdrawn, while Xi King Chouning, Northern Court Great King Pununing, army commander Pide, and others pursued and all won victories.

literal: Changshi Qinde was sent with an edict to praise them, and an edict also ordered Palace Attendant Mojie to command the armies and proceed to the imperial camp.
idiomatic: Changshi Qinde was sent with an edict commending them, and Palace Attendant Mojie was ordered to command the armies and proceed to the imperial camp.

literal: Pinbu division military commissioner Heluqu, Huangpishi xiangwen Jieli, and others each submitted captured armor and weapons.
idiomatic: Pinbu division military commissioner Heluqu, Huangpishi xiangwen Jieli, and others each submitted captured arms and armor.

literal: An edict again ordered two divisions of tuqi cavalry to go to Weizhou to assist Talan.
idiomatic: An edict again ordered two divisions of tuqi cavalry to march to Weizhou to assist Talan.

literal: Horizontal tent langjun Laojunnu led the langjun to patrol north of Juyong.
idiomatic: Horizontal tent langjun Laojunnu led the langjun in patrolling north of Juyong.

literal: General Huage commanded Pingzhou horses and troops; horizontal tent langjun Nuge was made Huangpishi overseer, and langjun Yeli was made Northern Court overseer; each led infantry to Weizhou to assist Xiezhen.
idiomatic: General Huage commanded Pingzhou horses and troops; horizontal tent langjun Nuge was made Huangpishi overseer and langjun Yeli Northern Court overseer; each led infantry to Weizhou to assist Xiezhen.

literal: On gengxu day Xiezhen was made overall commander of horses and troops on all routes, Talan deputy camp commander for horses and troops, and Dizi army overseer,
idiomatic: On gengxu day Xiezhen was made overall commander of horses and troops on all routes, Talan deputy camp commander for horses and troops, and Dizi army overseer,

literal: replacing Daishanbu and Han Dewei.
idiomatic: replacing Daishanbu and Han Dewei.

literal: On guichou day, because Ai Zheng, Zhao Xizan, and Ying and Shuo deputy military commissioners Xi army junior officer Aililixia, Bohai junior officer Guanhai, and others had rebelled and entered Song, their households were registered and distributed as rewards to meritorious officers.
idiomatic: On guichou day, because Ai Zheng, Zhao Xizan, and the Ying and Shuo deputy military commissioners, the Xi army junior officer Aililixia, the Bohai junior officer Guanhai, and others had defected to Song, their households were registered and distributed among meritorious officers.

literal: Song generals Cao Bin and Mi Xin crossed north over the Juma River and faced yuyue Xiuge in camp, challenging battle; north and south the camps stretched six or seven li.
idiomatic: Song generals Cao Bin and Mi Xin crossed the Juma River to the north and faced yuyue Xiuge in camp, challenging battle; the opposing camps stretched six or seven li north and south.

literal: At that time the Emperor was fifty li east of Zhuo Prefecture.
idiomatic: At that time the Emperor was encamped fifty li east of Zhuo Prefecture.

literal: On jiayin day an edict ordered yuyue Xiuge, Xi King Chouning, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling, the Northern and Southern Court kings, and others to guard the waterways strictly so that enemy troops could not steal through to Zhuo Prefecture.
idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict ordered yuyue Xiuge, Xi King Chouning, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling, the Northern and Southern Court kings, and others to guard the waterways strictly so that enemy troops could not slip through to Zhuo Prefecture.

literal: On yimao day Xiuge and the others defeated the Song army, presented captured armor, weapons, and goods, and were granted an edict of praise.
idiomatic: On yimao day Xiuge and the others routed the Song army, presented captured armor, weapons, and goods, and received an edict of commendation.

literal: Weizhou left and right chief clerks Li Cunzhang, Xu Yanqin, and others killed military commissioner Xiao Chuoli, seized the city overseer, and took Copper Prefecture military commissioner Geng Shaozhong captive; they rebelled with the city and went over to Song.
idiomatic: Weizhou left and right chief clerks Li Cunzhang and Xu Yanqin and others killed military commissioner Xiao Chuoli, seized the city overseer, and took Copper Prefecture military commissioner Geng Shaozhong captive; they surrendered the city and defected to Song.

literal: On bingchen day Zhuo Prefecture was recovered and heaven and earth were notified.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Zhuo Prefecture was recovered and heaven and earth were notified.

literal: On wuwu day the Emperor halted at the shoal north of the Shagu River and summoned yulin Qinde to discuss military affairs.
idiomatic: On wuwu day the Emperor encamped at the shoal north of the Shagu River and summoned yulin Qinde to discuss military affairs.

literal: The various officers each presented what they had captured.
idiomatic: Each of the officers presented his captives and booty.

literal: Xi King Chouning and the Northern and Southern Court kings led the officers of their divisions to court.
idiomatic: Xi King Chouning and the Northern and Southern Court kings led the officers of their divisions to court.

literal: A fallen hawk presented by attendant Nianmili was used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: The court sacrificed to heaven and earth with a fallen hawk presented by attendant Nianmili.

literal: On jiwei day Xiuge and Puling came to court; an edict ordered the Three Departments to supply summer clothing cloth to the armies at the front.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Xiuge and Puling came to court; an edict ordered the Three Departments to supply summer clothing cloth to the armies at the front.

literal: On gengshen day the Emperor paid court to the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the Emperor attended court before the Empress Dowager.

literal: On xinyou day the main army halted at Gu'an.
idiomatic: On xinyou day the main army encamped at Gu'an.

literal: On renxu day Gu'an city was besieged; army commander Pide was first to ascend the wall, the city was then taken, and captives were released freely.
idiomatic: On renxu day the army besieged Gu'an; army commander Pide was first over the wall, the city fell, and captives were taken freely.

literal: Residents who had earlier been taken captive were ordered ransomed with official goods.
idiomatic: Residents who had earlier been taken captive were allowed to ransom themselves with official goods.

literal: On jiazi day the troops who stormed the city were rewarded in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the troops who stormed the city were rewarded according to rank.

literal: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, the Liao army fought Cao Bin and Mi Xin at Qigou Pass and routed them, pursuing to the Juma River; those who drowned were beyond counting.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, the Liao army fought Cao Bin and Mi Xin at Qigou Pass and crushed them, pursuing to the Juma River; the drowned were beyond counting.

literal: The survivors fled to Gaoyang and were again struck by the Liao army; tens of thousands died and discarded arms and armor like hills.
idiomatic: The survivors fled to Gaoyang and were struck again by the Liao army; tens of thousands died and cast off arms and armor in heaps like hills.

literal: Several tens of thousands of grain-transport conscripts hid in the empty city at Qigou and were surrounded.
idiomatic: Several tens of thousands of grain-transport conscripts hid in the empty city at Qigou and were surrounded.

literal: On renshen day, because it was the Empress Dowager's birthday, they were released and allowed to return.
idiomatic: On renshen day, because it was the Empress Dowager's birthday, the siege was lifted and they were allowed to go.

literal: On guiyou day the army withdrew and halted again at Xincheng.
idiomatic: On guiyou day the army withdrew and encamped again at Xincheng.

literal: Xiuge and Puling memorialized that all Song soldiers who fled in flight were killed.
idiomatic: Xiuge and Puling reported that all Song soldiers caught in flight were killed.

literal: On jiaxu day, because of the military victory, envoys were dispatched separately to announce it to the various capitals and garrison commands.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day, because of the victory, envoys were sent separately to announce it to the various capitals and garrison commands.

literal: On dingchou day an edict ordered the various officers that merit would be assessed and rewards granted without any falsehood.
idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered the various officers that merit would be assessed and rewards granted without favoritism or false credit.

literal: On jimao day the court halted south of Gu'an and used a green ox and white horse to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On jimao day the court encamped south of Gu'an and sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: On gengchen day captured Song men were used to shoot ghost arrows.
idiomatic: On gengchen day captured Song men were used in the ghost-arrow rite.

literal: An edict dispatched xiangwen Paiya to lead Hongyi army troops and the four armies of the Northern and Southern Pishi, langjun, and zhaila to the borders of Ying and Shuo prefectures to join tihu Yaosheng, pacification commissioner Han Dewei, and others in resisting Song troops in Shanxi who had not yet withdrawn.
idiomatic: An edict sent xiangwen Paiya to lead Hongyi army troops and the four armies of the Northern and Southern Pishi, langjun, and zhaila to the borders of Ying and Shuo prefectures to join tihu Yaosheng, pacification commissioner Han Dewei, and others in holding off Song forces in Shanxi that had not yet withdrawn.

literal: On xinsi day Yaosheng's army was sent to Shanxi.
idiomatic: On xinsi day Yaosheng's army was dispatched to Shanxi.

literal: On renwu day the court halted again at Nanjing.
idiomatic: On renwu day the court encamped again at Nanjing.

literal: On guiwei day Xiuge, Chouning, and Pununing presented captives.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Xiuge, Chouning, and Pununing presented captives.

literal: Xiezhen sent judge Pugu to memorialize the recovery of Weizhou; more than twenty thousand heads were cut off; taking advantage of victory Lingqiu and Feihu were also taken; Pugu was granted wine and silver vessels.
idiomatic: Xiezhen sent judge Pugu to report the recovery of Weizhou; more than twenty thousand heads were taken; pressing the victory, Lingqiu and Feihu were also captured; Pugu was granted wine and silver vessels.

literal: On bingxu day the court attended at Yuanhe Hall and held a great banquet for the officers who had followed the campaign; Xiuge was enfeoffed as King of Song; Puling, Chouning, Pununing, and other meritorious officers were granted titles and rewards in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the court attended at Yuanhe Hall and held a great banquet for the officers who had followed the campaign; Xiuge was enfeoffed King of Song; Puling, Chouning, Pununing, and other meritorious officers received titles and rewards according to rank.

literal: On dinghai day the court departed Nanjing; an edict ordered Xiuge to prepare armor and weapons, store grain, and wait until autumn for a major southern campaign.
idiomatic: On dinghai day the court left Nanjing; an edict ordered Xiuge to ready armor and weapons, store grain, and wait until autumn for a major southern campaign.

literal: On wuzi day Xiezhen memorialized that the Song army again besieged Weizhou and was broken and defeated.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Xiezhen reported that the Song army had again besieged Weizhou and was routed.

literal: An edict granted troops to Yaosheng, Han Dewei, and others.
idiomatic: An edict assigned troops to Yaosheng, Han Dewei, and others.

literal: On renchen day, because Song troops had reached Ping Prefecture and Yaosheng and Han Dewei had not pursued and killed them to the full, a descending edict rebuked and reproached them.
idiomatic: On renchen day, because Song troops had reached Ping Prefecture and Yaosheng and Han Dewei had not pursued and destroyed them fully, an edict descended rebuking them.

literal: They were also instructed that those who held cities and had not yet submitted must be wholly overrun and killed, with none allowed to escape.
idiomatic: They were also told that any who still held cities and had not submitted must be overrun and killed to the last, with none allowed to escape.

literal: On guisi day surrendered soldiers from the front were distributed separately among the imperial escort.
idiomatic: On guisi day surrendered soldiers from the front were distributed among the imperial escort.

literal: On yiwei day Pide's officers, soldiers, and troops were rewarded.
idiomatic: On yiwei day the officers, soldiers, and troops under Pide were rewarded.

literal: In the sixth month, on the wuxu new moon, an edict ordered Han Dewei to come to court; army commander Pide was additionally made honorary Grand Preceptor.
idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the sixth month an edict ordered Han Dewei to come to court; army commander Pide was additionally granted honorary grand preceptor.

literal: On jiachen day an edict ordered Nanjing regent Xiuge to send artillerymen west to assist Xiezhen.
idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict ordered Nanjing regent Xiuge to send artillerymen west to assist Xiezhen.

literal: On yisi day the yilibi Zheligu division escorted baggage to the mobile palace; marching in summer heat fifty li a day, men and horses were exhausted; envoys were sent to rebuke them.
idiomatic: On yisi day the yilibi Zheligu division escorted baggage to the mobile palace; forced to march fifty li a day in summer heat, men and horses were exhausted; envoys were sent to rebuke them.

literal: On dingwei day the court passed Juyong Pass.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the court passed through Juyong Pass.

literal: On renzi day the Nanjing regent memorialized that the people's annual payment of Three Departments salt-and-iron money, when converted to silk, did not equal its value; an edict ordered the amount increased.
idiomatic: On renzi day the Nanjing regent reported that the people's annual payment of Three Departments salt-and-iron money, when converted to silk, fell short of its value; an edict ordered the amount increased.

literal: On jiayin day Xiezhen memorialized the recovery of Huan Prefecture.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Xiezhen reported the recovery of Huan Prefecture.

literal: On yimao day the imperial consort, princes, and princesses welcomed the Emperor beyond the pass; they set an imperial canopy beside the road, placed Emperor Jingzong's portrait, led the attending ministers in presenting wine, displayed captives before them, and then held a great banquet.
idiomatic: On yimao day the imperial consort, princes, and princesses welcomed the Emperor beyond the pass; they set an imperial canopy beside the road, placed Emperor Jingzong's portrait, led the attending ministers in presenting wine, displayed captives before them, and then held a great banquet.

literal: On wuwu day the court visited Liangyi Pass.
idiomatic: On wuwu day the court went to Liangyi Pass.

literal: Captives were distributed separately among the imperial clan and wet nurses.
idiomatic: Captives were distributed among the imperial clan and wet nurses.
